header: This is the "Deep search (EDS)" tab of the user guide (text and list in src/lib/help/edsGuide.ts): what EDS covers today, what it is, what the back end does when a circular is uploaded and when an executive asks, which AI model works at each step, and the questions to test it with. I show each question with its measured score (the real detector, synthesisIntent.ts): 5 or more reaches EDS as typed. "Try it" puts a question in the search bar (the reader still presses Enter).
